desc:
🍎 Be the teacher! Run your class, grade homework & catch the cheaters!

✏️ Answer your students' questions and grade their homework!
🚨 Check backpacks at the security gate and stamp the right paper!
👀 Catch the cheaters during the pop quiz before it's too late!
💰 Earn Cash for every good decision and upgrade your classroom!
🏫 Level up from Kindergarten to College with bigger rewards!
🔄 Rebirth to unlock new themes, new games and progress even further!

🏆 Become the BEST teacher in school and ace every day!

👍 Like the game and let us know your feedback!
